title: Moment propagation
what: Per-unit means and variances propagated layer by layer through the ReLU (the Gaussian moment closure); scale modes, centers, rms normalisation.

title: Covariance structure
what: The carried cross-covariance structure between units: pair map, Gram products, the dead-cut star, kink and cross-covariance terms.

title: Third-order planes
what: Third-cumulant corrections carried as low-rank planes (the K21, K31 and K13 families): the plane bank, its push and read, its rank and its feed into the means.

title: Fourth-order terms
what: Fourth-cumulant corrections (the K4L families, k4 bands, kurtosis offsets).

title: Birth terms
what: Terms for newborn directions entering the carried basis.

title: Late-layer exactness
what: Exact evaluation and row cuts at the last layers (layers 14 and 15).

title: Learned per-layer correction
what: The learned per-layer correction network (observer, edge module, per-layer heads), its training and its refits.

title: On-policy readout
what: The second-step linear readout fitted by ridge regression on captures of the estimator's own trajectory.

title: Dials
what: Scalar coefficients set by finite-difference line search (GSK, BFIX gamma, SS beta, NP strength, K4L_C, k4 bands, row-cut z and others).

title: Arithmetic kernels
what: Exact kernels that lower the metered FLOP count: Strassen and Winograd products, grouped (Smirnov) reads, symmetric Gram, float32 transports, padding rules.

title: Join sketch
what: Randomised low-rank sketches of the joined plane columns: the Nystrom join sketch, the power-step sketch, kc, join truncation.

title: Sampling estimators
what: Monte Carlo and other sampling-based estimators, comparators and truth generation.

title: Series expansions
what: Analytic expansions used in derivations: Hermite, Mehler, linked-cluster and cumulant series.

title: FLOP accounting
what: Composition of the metered bill: push and read shares, request counts, the request diet, caching, census, byte-identical cuts.

title: Wall clock and residual time
what: The 120 s wall-clock and 0.4 s residual-time limits: sync points, garbage-collector control, lazy binds, governors, margin tails.

title: Setup budget
what: The 5 s setup cap and prebinding.

title: Rules compliance
what: Conformance with the official rules: fair accounting, dead code, imports, scatter-for-gather.

title: Evaluation methodology
what: How candidates were measured locally and how local numbers transfer to the hosted grader: paired stores, cross-half truth, fresh cohorts, torch versus native.

title: Error attribution
what: Where the remaining error lives: oracles, inherited error by layer, comparisons with the leaders.

title: Hosted platform
what: Behaviour of the hosted grader and leaderboard: scoring formula, public and private split, warm versus cold workers, timing jitter.

title: Submission process
what: Which files were submitted, when and why; approvals, failures, designations.

title: Team process
what: Leads, agent roles, handoffs, working rules.

title: Tooling
what: Gates, scorers, builders, scanners, queue runners.
